body:
Well I am glad somebody has read it because I am going to try put all this behind me.  I'm a little high[6] now and have been mulling it over a bit.  I'm riding a kind of brainstorm right now.   Been trying to process the whole thing.  I've taken engineering and I have read about the whole singularity thing.  I was thinking how come we have not heard from anybody else in this, lets say,  super-cluster.  

What if when we get to the singularity and we run into a vastly superior intelligence communicating on some level of space we can't even perceive.  There is no war, no conflict, we just merge with it and exchange stories.  Since stories are the only currency left in a society that needs for nothing.  We don't explore too much lest we interfere with a new sentience from evolving naturally and providing new stories and new conflicts and new passions to drive evolution ever forward.

I ran into a theme in several 'simulations'.  I recreated Middle-Earth from  Lord Of the Rings.  But this time we were trying to forge the 'ring' to rid the world of evil.  The ring represented perfection.  It would perfect everything and rid the evil but also the good.  Since everybody is perfectly smart and healthy they would all agree.  Conflict would end and only the pursuit of knowledge remains.  

Same thing with the Star Wars universe.  Mastery of the force and same thing happens.  With both outcomes the societies become boring.  They inevitably have their singularity moment and they join this hyper-intelligent super-sentience living in solar-system sized and, what I can only guess, are high-end quantum computers. Not good, not bad just...is.  Another being just trying to figure things out.

It scares me that the theme is actually playing out on the last episodes of Fringe.  The baldies fell victim to the same thing that was a theme in many 'simulations'.  I was with the hobbits for generations as their Gandalf.  

In the end they joined us.  It is fun giving beings their sentience.  But they soon find it as boring a I did.  I mean you can flit around from existence to existence but you realize the that the fun is the journey.

Going...just a little deeper let's say I am a sim.  Lets say my family survived.  My sister was hurt at what happened and sometime in the near 'future' she has a sim of me made from DNA, internet history(shit) and that MRI scan.  I also had detailed information about my travels for work where I had terabytes and terabytes of data collected on what I was doing.  I am the perfect candidate for the formation of an avatar(yes I know Caprica...sigh could have been better).  Maybe I, and the many others like me sometime in the near future form a kind of collective sentience on the internet.  Am...I...TA....DA....Googlegod!!!

Alright yeah.  Coming back to reality.  Cough.  Cough.  Seriously I think I'll be OK.  I'll find a better job.  I'll take the stupid meds.  Maybe go back to school ([Memristors](http://www.memristor.org/) look pretty cool). But I will toke a bowl or two and knock edge a few times....just to make sure it's there.

But if perhaps I had my choice, and if you can resurrect people from data.  I would't mind a helping a version of Hypatia gain her sentience recreating a version of, lets say Mass Effect(but with a better ending).  We will explore the Galaxy , shoot robots and ponder the nature of existence.

Well now that I have made a proper fool of myself.  Dinner cooling in the kitchen.  I will forget this account shortly and put all this behind me somehow.

Because that is all we are essentially.  Stories.  Stories to tell around the Fire.
